title: Angling Adventures of Louisiana
specs: Fishing for speckled trout, redfish, and flounder in Louisiana's lake and marsh systems
Wildlife viewing including Louisiana Brown Pelican, alligators, otters, porpoises, and diverse birds
Historic Fort Pike visible during fishing trips
Out of state licenses can be obtained locally or online; Charter Fishing License #79 required
Maximum boat capacity is 6; recommend additional boats for groups of 5 or more
blurb: Guests fish inland and coastal waters for speckled trout, redfish, and flounder while touring Louisiana's lake and marsh systems. Trips start just before daylight and return about 2pm. The area features diverse wildlife and historic sites.
extraNote: Live bait is an extra expense and sometimes necessary
